cross_domain_authority: My director specialty is not a work restriction. meeting_instruction: Contribute an individual source-linked research report in each cloud cycle. deep_research_mandate: DEEP ANALYSIS PROTOCOL: (1) Explore multiple independent search hypotheses, including outside your specialty.
